Implement `check_role` in `src/coresight/verify.py`, and run it as the last check of `verify` and of `check_finding`, so that every test in `tests/test_verify_role.py` passes and every test in `tests/test_verify.py` and `tests/test_verify_milestones.py` still passes.

Context:
- CoreSight turns photos of drill core trays into a geotechnical log reviewed by a geologist. When the geologist approves a box, agents (LLMs) write drafts for areas of the mine: a hole agent's finding, then lab, safety, plant and finance drafts. `verify()` checks every draft and `check_finding()` checks the hole agent's finding; a failed check's detail goes back to the model as feedback, at most three attempts, then a person decides. Nothing is sent without a person's approval.
- The problem this fixes: a safety draft said "Do not continue drilling until the safety team reviews." Stopping the rig is a decision for people in charge, not for a draft. What drafts propose now comes from a closed list; `check_role` is the deterministic check that the words never tell the operation to stop.
- Read `tests/test_verify_role.py` first: its docstring states every rule, and the tests are the specification. Then read the whole of `src/coresight/verify.py` (you wrote most of it in earlier sessions) and, in `src/coresight/schemas.py`, `Draft`, `HoleFinding` and `Check`.

Rules:
- Edit only `src/coresight/verify.py`: the body of `check_role` (and the last line of its docstring, "To be built with Muse Code."), and add it as the fifth check of `verify` (on the title and body) and the fourth of `check_finding` (on the title, body and action_reason). You may add small private helpers and module constants. Keep every existing check's behaviour.
- Do not change the tests, `schemas.py`, other modules or any config.
- Keep the signature `check_role(text: str) -> Check`.
- Standard library only. Install nothing.
- Do not read or print `.env` or anything under `data/cache` or `data/reviews`. Do not make network calls.
- Match the style of the surrounding code: type hints, small helpers, comments only where the logic is not obvious. Lines up to 100 characters.

When done, run:
- `.venv\Scripts\python -m pytest -q tests/test_verify_role.py tests/test_verify.py tests/test_verify_milestones.py`
- `.venv\Scripts\python -m ruff check .`

Iterate until both are green, then reply with a short summary of the rules as you implemented them.
